grader.scenario: Hub 5 port forwarding rules disappearing after night reboot; resolved via firmware 4.12.3 flash and NVRAM cloud commit
grader.notes: Flawless advanced technical call demonstrating deep empathy in the middle third, firmware deployment, harmless recheck in the final third, and complete resolution verification.

items.name: Branding and Survey Check
items.evidence: Agent opened with 'Thank you for calling S-Net advanced technical support' at [00:00] and closed with 'Thank you for choosing S-Net' in final lines.

items.name: Hold time and Dead Air
items.evidence: Hold was announced with could I place you on hold and thanked upon return without unmanaged dead air.

items.name: Verified customer
items.evidence: Verified full postal address and security PIN within the first 240 seconds.

items.name: Personalized the call/ticket appropriately
items.evidence: Agent addressed customer as Rhiannon throughout the call.

items.name: Empathy & Acknowledgment Statement
items.evidence: Agent demonstrated exceptional empathy at turn 22 ('I completely understand the immense pressure, regulatory anxiety, and exhausting late nights this has caused you and your dental practice, Rhiannon...') and customer had no unhandled outbursts.

items.name: Paraphrasing
items.evidence: Agent accurately paraphrased the NVRAM port forwarding persistence failure at turn 2.

items.name: Active listening
items.evidence: Agent completed harmless recheck of customer account reference at turn 42.

items.name: Took ownership of the problem
items.evidence: Agent flashed firmware patch 4.12.3, bound rules to cloud profile, simulated live reboot, and verified persistence.

items.name: Build rapport and observed professionalism
items.evidence: Agent maintained an exemplary, supportive, and highly technical professional demeanor throughout.

items.name: Probing
items.evidence: Agent probed about TrueNAS IP reservations, port ranges, and backup schedules.

items.name: Confirmed the issue is resolved
items.evidence: Router rebooted on call, rules verified persistent in web GUI, and TrueNAS SSL login page accessed over cellular data.
